product.name: Hypersonic Air-Breathing Propulsion System
product.description: A propulsion system that uses atmospheric oxygen to power hypersonic flight, improving fuel efficiency compared to traditional rockets.

product.name: Small-Scale Ramjet Engine
product.description: A compact ramjet engine that operates by compressing incoming air at high speeds without turbo machinery, suitable for hypersonic applications.

product.name: Hypersonic Space Plane
product.description: A vehicle capable of horizontal takeoff and hypersonic flight, designed to access orbit using air-breathing propulsion for improved fuel efficiency.
